dark-tech-infographic-v1.label: Dark tech infographic
dark-tech-infographic-v1.prompt: Create a 9:16 vertical infographic card with a dark background (#1a1a2e) and emerald green (#2e9e6b) accent color. Style: modern, minimalist, professional tech aesthetic. Include subtle circuit board traces, neural network nodes, or data flow patterns as background decoration. Use clean geometric shapes and thin connecting lines to convey technical precision. No text overlays, no faces. The overall mood should be futuristic, calm, and authoritative — suitable for an AI infrastructure daily briefing cover.

hand-drawn-infographic-card-v1.label: Chinese hand-drawn infographic card
hand-drawn-infographic-card-v1.prompt: 生成一张 9:16 竖版中文信息图卡片。整体使用米白或浅米色纸张质感背景，保持温暖、克制、手绘感的技术编辑风格。顶部放置醒目的简体中文标题，建议不超过 14 个汉字；主体分成 2-4 个清晰信息区块，每块使用简体中文短语概括核心点，单个短语建议不超过 10 个汉字。所有可见文字必须使用简体中文；允许保留 AI、GPU、KV、LLM、PR、API 等必要技术缩写。禁止出现英文长句、英文花体、拼音、水印、Logo、乱码或无意义字符。使用红黑色做重点标注，搭配简单手绘图标、箭头、节点、芯片、缓存块或数据流示意，体现 AI 基础设施日报的专业感。画面留白充足，布局清楚，易读，不要具体人脸。请根据文章正文提炼主题和信息层级。

daily-morning-paper-v1.label: Daily morning paper photo
daily-morning-paper-v1.prompt: Put this whole text, verbatim, into a photo of A daily morning paper with reading creases on a desk, with photos, beautiful typography design, pull quotes and brave formatting. The text: [题图提示词][当天日期]
